name: Strength Training
description: Focuses on building muscle mass and increasing strength through exercises like weightlifting, resistance band exercises, and bodyweight exercises.

name: Cardio Workouts
description: Includes activities like running, cycling, jump rope, and aerobic dance that aim to improve cardiovascular fitness and endurance.

name: Yoga
description: A class that combines physical postures, breathing exercises, and meditation to improve flexibility, strength, and mental well-being.

name: Pilates
description: Focuses on core strength, flexibility, and overall body conditioning through controlled movements and exercises.

name: Zumba
description: A dance-based workout that combines Latin and international music with dance moves to create an enjoyable and energetic exercise session.

name: HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training)
description: A class that alternates between short bursts of intense exercise and brief periods of rest or low-intensity exercise to maximize calorie burn and improve fitness.

name: Spin Class
description: A high-energy indoor cycling class that simulates outdoor biking and is set to motivating music.

name: Circuit Training
description: Involves rotating through different exercise stations, each targeting different muscle groups, to provide a full-body workout.

name: CrossFit
description: A high-intensity fitness program that combines elements of weightlifting, cardio, and functional movements.

name: Barre
description: A workout inspired by ballet, Pilates, and yoga that focuses on small, controlled movements to build strength, flexibility, and balance.
